name: hazen-colloidal-borescope-sso-2024
description: Colloidal-borescope measurement of groundwater flow in the ENIGMA Subsurface Observatory (Field Test Plan 'Identification of Flow Vectors Using Colloidal Borescope with Full Installation of Aqua TROLL and Level TROLL Telemetry Monitoring Systems at the SSO', Hazen Lab, 2024). A colloidal borescope (Geotech, Denver, CO) was lowered into the screened intervals of wells M4, M5 and L9 (saturated zones SZ1, SZ2 and, in M5, SZ3) at 1-ft steps below the top of casing and left for a few to ~40 minutes per depth while its camera tracked colloids; the instrument software logs each tracked particle's azimuth (degrees clockwise from north; magnetic declination set to 0), speed (um/s) and particle count, and reports per measurement the arithmetic average, median, minimum, maximum and standard deviation of direction and speed, the number of data points and its flow-vector estimate (direction and speed), which it withholds when the data are unreliable. Samplers called a depth 'preferential flow' when a consistent fast vector was seen (log files suffixed _Pref). Measurements: 2024-01-31 (M4-SZ1, L9-SZ1), 02-05 (L9-SZ2, M4-SZ2), 02-08 (M5-SZ1, M5-SZ2), 02-09 (M5-SZ3, heavy rainfall) and 02-26 (M5 repeats). The plan also cites 63 measurements of April-May 2023 (VSZ, SZ1, SZ2 of all SSO wells) that are not on the team Drive.
